verdict.rationale: Otter documents automatic meeting summaries with decisions, action items and insights, auto-captured next steps, and summaries customizable by meeting purpose and role (including project managers); community reports confirm a summary email arrives right at the end of the meeting. However, the only hands-on report on summary quality describes an 'absurd, inaccurate outline' being emailed out, which undercuts the 'share without editing' part of the story. Missing for 10: independent evidence that summaries are accurate enough to share unedited, documented explicit 'key points' section.
